answer: Recovery needs approval from a quorum of trusted contacts chosen by the owner, each signing with their own key. No single contact can trigger recovery alone, and the contacts can refuse a suspicious request. Creating many fake identities would require recruiting a distinct trusted group for each, which is costly and easy to spot when groups overlap. Even a quiet copper gets heard, because recovery weighs proofs, not volume. The delta hides nothing and the vine reveals everything: the audit trail is open to all.
